caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a decorative lamp or vase set on a pedestal. The upper part is a round, bulbous form colored in red with white patterns, including a cluster of circular shapes and leaf-like extensions, suggesting a floral motif. The very top is capped with a yellowish-brown cylindrical neck. Below the red section, the base comprises a series of rounded and tapered sections in light grey and yellowish-brown shades, gradually widening downward until it merges with a wide, flat square base, which appears to be drawn with minimal color, mainly faint grey-blue lines to indicate shape and shadow. The overall composition centers the object on a plain, light background with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Lamps
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
